note: Submodule of graphql_compose. Exposes blocks (Block Content entities + rendered block plugins) to the GraphQL Compose schema. You enable a block content bundle via entity_config.block_content.<bundle>.enabled in graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config on the block_content.basic bundle (baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr' per campaign guidance.

evals.prompt: What does the graphql_compose_blocks submodule add to a Drupal GraphQL Compose schema, and what module does it require besides graphql_compose?
evals.expected_output: It adds Drupal blocks to the schema: a BlockContent EntityType plugin (so custom block content bundles can be exposed), a BlockField field type, and BlockInterface/BlockContent/BlockPlugin/BlockUnion schema types with resolvers. It requires the core block_content module.

evals.prompt: Using graphql_compose_blocks, which config key exposes a custom block content bundle (say 'basic') in the GraphQL schema?
evals.expected_output: Set entity_config.block_content.basic.enabled = true in graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server (same mechanism as any entity type).

evals.prompt: In graphql_compose_blocks, how would you make a custom block plugin class resolve to the right type inside the BlockUnion GraphQL type?
evals.expected_output: Implement hook_graphql_compose_blocks_union_alter($value, ?string &$type) and set $type to the desired GraphQL type name when $value matches your block class.

evals.prompt: On this site a custom block content bundle has been exposed in GraphQL Compose. Inspect the graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server config and name the block_content bundle that is enabled.
Using graphql_compose_blocks, expose the 'basic' block content bundle in the GraphQL schema on the default GraphQL Compose server. Apply the change to the live configuration.
